newsitem.title: USA: FPL names planning, development head.
newsitem.headline: FPL names planning, development head.

text.p: FPL Group Inc said Thomas F. Kirk has been appointed vice president of planning, development, and quality.
The planning position previously existed at Florida Power & Light Co, FPL's utility subsidiary; but has not been filled for some time, spokesman Bill Swank said.
The company said Kirk will be responsible for analyzing potential acquisitions, evaluating new business ventures, overseeing the company's strategic planning, and leading FPL's quality program.

From 1987 through 1996, Kirk held management positions in finance, planning and development, including chief financial officer, with Rhone-Poulenc. He most recently was vice president and chief financial officer of Quaker Chemical Corp. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
